functionalReqs: Start from seed URLs and follow links
Download HTML pages and store them for indexing
Skip duplicate URLs and duplicate content
hints: Is the crawl BFS or DFS, and why does one of them hurt websites?
Design a URL frontier with front queues for priority and back queues per host for politeness.

Pipeline: frontier → DNS resolver (cached) → fetcher → parser → content-seen check (hash) → link extractor → URL filter → URL-seen check (bloom filter) → frontier. Add robots.txt caching and spider-trap protection such as a maximum URL depth.
nonFunctionalReqs: Robust against bad HTML, traps and slow servers
Scales to 1 billion pages per month
problemStatement:
Design a **web crawler** that downloads web pages for a search engine index, starting from a set of seed URLs and following links.

It must be polite to websites, avoid downloading the same content twice, and scale to billions of pages.

scaleHints.storage: ~500 KB per page, ~30 PB over 5 years
